steps.en: The reviewed notice list is displayed
steps.why_en: No review list screen exists for court applications.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada layar daftar review untuk court application.

steps.en: A count summary of notices is displayed
steps.why_en: No count summary exists; the court report is an empty placeholder.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada ringkasan jumlah; laporan court hanya placeholder kosong.

steps.en: Officer confirms submission to State Courts
steps.id: Petugas mengonfirmasi pengajuan ke State Courts
steps.why_en: No confirm action exists; sending to the courts cannot be verified here.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada aksi konfirmasi; pengiriman ke court tidak bisa diverifikasi di sini.

steps.en: Officer goes back to continue reviewing
steps.why_en: There is no review screen to go back to.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada layar review untuk kembali.
